items.title: Uber Eats expands U.S. grocery delivery network
items.summary: Uber Technologies (NYSE:UBER) has broadened its grocery delivery offerings by partnering with several regional grocery chains across the United States. The expansion adds a number of locally recognized retailers, including Busch’s Fresh Food Market, Hays, Lowe’s Market, and Piggly Wiggly, to the Uber Eats platform.
